error.title: Couldn't load incidents
error.sub: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No incidents reported
empty.sub: When something goes wrong on a project or site, file it here so it can be investigated and closed out.
empty.noMatchSub: Try a different status or clear the search.

Investigating.title: Start investigating {{type}}?
Investigating.body: This moves the incident to Investigating so the team can record findings. You can close it once the investigation is complete.

Closed.title: Close {{type}}?
Closed.body: This marks the incident Closed. Closed is the final state; reopen by filing a follow-up if new information emerges.

delete.title: Delete {{type}}?
delete.body: This permanently removes the incident report. This can't be undone; consider closing it instead to keep the audit trail.

detail.notFoundSub: This incident either doesn't exist or isn't visible to you. Return to the register to find it.
detail.errorSub: Something went wrong fetching the incident report.
detail.escalatedBody: This issue passed its due time on {{date}}; the person in charge and the project manager were told.
detail.taskLinked: A task was created for this issue.

form.typePlaceholder: e.g. Near Miss, Equipment Damage, Spill
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, who was involved, and any immediate action taken.
form.actionPlaceholder: e.g. Replace the damaged guard rail
form.uploadFailed: The issue was saved, but a photo could not be uploaded. Your text is kept — retry to send the remaining photos.
form.invalidDueTime: The due time is not valid in your timezone.

close.notePlaceholder: What was done to fix it.
close.proofRequired: A close photo is required for a High or Critical issue.

rootCause.label: Root cause
